name: calendar
behavior: APG grid pattern as used by the Date Picker Dialog: the month is a role=grid of week rows and day gridcells, with a roving tabindex so exactly one day is tabbable. Arrow keys move by day and by week, Home/End go to the start/end of the week, PageUp/PageDown change month (Shift+PageUp/PageDown change year), Enter/Space selects. Selected days carry aria-selected, unavailable days aria-disabled, and every day button's accessible name is its full date. The month/year caption names the grid and month changes are announced.

parts.note: one or more month panels side by side
the previous/next row aligned with the caption
the month/year label; the dropdown caption layout swaps the text for two selects — a composition with the select anatomy
abbreviated weekday header; its full name is exposed to assistive tech
the gridcell; carries range position so the range fill can bleed edge to edge between cells

parts.statesNote: today is marked with selected-indicator, not with the selected recipe; outside-month and unavailable days use content-disabled

anatomyNotes: Intersection of shadcn Calendar (react-day-picker: root/months/month/nav/month_caption/month_grid/weekdays/week/day/day_button) and Salt date-components Calendar (CalendarNavigation/CalendarGrid/CalendarWeekHeader/CalendarDay). Both resolve to the parts above. Cell size is bound to control-height-sm and radius-control — there is deliberately no size axis, because a calendar grid must stay square and a theme's density axis already moves control-height-sm. Range selection (start/middle/end) and 'today' are POSITION/ANNOTATION attributes on the day part (data-range-*, data-today), not canonical states: they compose with selected rather than replacing it. Salt's per-day status colouring (highlighted/unselectable reasons) is a recipe on day-button. Multi-month display is layout on root, not extra anatomy.
